claims.text: For body text, Northwind's checklist requires a contrast ratio of 4.5:1 against its background.
Large text needs 3:1, and the design work targets WCAG 2.2 level AA.
NW-SPR-B covers logo, colour, type, a 30-page brand book, and one simple logo animation.
It is priced at €9,500 over 4 weeks.
No, unused hours are not refunded.

Unused retainer hours are never refunded, even where the Client cancels, pauses, or simply does not send work.
Unused hours roll over to the next month only and then expire.
All web and product design delivered by Northwind targets WCAG 2.2 level AA.
The legal terms also state that this is the accessibility target for the design, though meeting it is not a certification of the client's implemented product.
The sources do not describe what happens if a client never replies to design drafts, so I don't know based on the Northwind documents.

No, the Design System Audit does not include doing the fixes.

The Master Services Agreement likewise states that the audit "does not include doing the fixes".

I don't know based on the Northwind documents whether they could take on frontend work for your project.
The answer depends on the date of written confirmation, and the current date isn't given in the sources.
A rush confirmed in writing before 1 March 2026 carries a 25% fee, and one confirmed on or after 1 March 2026 carries a 40% fee.
The rate in force on the date of written confirmation applies even if the work is delivered later.
No, Northwind does not have an office in Amsterdam.
Our only office is in Lloydkwartier, Rotterdam.
The Amsterdam office belongs to Byteharbour, our partner studio, not to Northwind.
No.
Unused retainer hours roll over to the next month only, and then expire.
Rolled-over hours are used first, and unused hours are never refunded, including on cancellation.
No, the urgent line is not available on the Studio plan.
It is available only on the Partner plan, covering Northwind's working hours plus 07:00 to 09:00 CET.
Studio clients get a same-working-day first reply but no urgent line.
No.
The October 2025 draft that proposed a Studio price of €6,200 was rejected, and the in-force Studio price from 1 January 2026 is €5,800 a month.
The 25% rush fee applies, because the rate in force on the date of written confirmation governs even when delivery falls in March.
The 40% fee only starts on 1 March 2026 and does not reach back to rushes already confirmed.
There is no Dutch VAT on Kestrel's invoice because Kestrel is an EU business outside the Netherlands, so the invoice is issued under reverse charge.
Kestrel Analytics is based in Ireland, and Northwind does not add Dutch VAT to such invoices; the client accounts for the VAT in their own country.
Sandra Tsapljoek is the account lead for Kestrel Analytics.
She is listed as the account lead for Kestrel Analytics in the team directory.
Harbor file uploads failed for 3 hours 20 minutes on 14 April 2026, from 10:05 to 13:25 CET.
Downloads and the rest of the portal were not part of that failure, based on the incident summary.
Twenty-three clients were affected by the Harbor upload outage on 14 April 2026.
They were all emailed the same day.
Northwind does not design or build native mobile apps, but the studio it points clients to for native apps is Byteharbour, which builds React Native mobile apps.
Byteharbour's office is in Amsterdam.
You receive 8 free design hours added once to your account when a company you refer signs a retainer.
The hours are a one-time benefit and do not repeat on later retainers, renewals, or larger plans.
You should tell your account lead the company's name and that you are the referrer before they sign.
No, we do not put confidential client briefs into public AI tools.
Northwind's policy bans pasting client files, confidential briefs, or even shortened versions of them into public AI tools.
The built-in AI features in Figma may only be used on client files that are not under a confidentiality clause.
The Studio retainer is €5,800 per month, covering 64 design hours and 2 active requests.
A draft 2026 proposal suggested raising it to €6,200 per month, but that was only a draft for discussion.
A Brand Sprint costs €9.500 and takes 4 weeks.
It includes a logo, colour, type, a 30-page brand book, and a simple logo animation.
A retainer prepaid annually in advance receives a 10% discount.
This is the current annual prepayment discount, and it cannot be combined with the non-profit discount.
The 15% figure from the 2024 archived pricing list is no longer applicable.
The rush fee is 40% from 1 March 2026, and before that date it was 25%.
A rush is charged on top of the normal cost, and a rush confirmed in writing before 1 March keeps the 25% rate even if delivery happens later.
You can take one or the other, but not both.
The non-profit discount is 15% on retainers for a registered non-profit.
The annual prepayment discount is 10% on a retainer paid for the year in advance, and it cannot be combined with the non-profit discount.
A third revision round on a Brand Sprint costs €450 on a fixed-price project, since Brand Sprints include two rounds per deliverable.
The sources do not mention any rush surcharge, so I don't know based on the Northwind documents whether a rushed round costs more.
No, the urgent line is available only on the Partner plan, with working hours plus 07:00–09:00 CET for launch blockers.
Starter's first reply is within 2 working days, and the schedule in the 2025 document shows no urgent line for Starter.
A proposal to extend the urgent line to Studio was discussed but not adopted.
A 10-hour rush request uses 14 hours of your retainer, because the rush fee is 40% from 1 March 2026 and is charged in hours on retainers.
This applies only if the rush is confirmed in writing by your account lead before it applies.
Those 14 hours come out of your monthly budget rather than being billed as an extra line on top.
If you cancel an annual retainer, the unused months are refunded minus the discount you received for those months.
The refund applies to unused months of prepayment, not to unused hours inside a month.
On the Studio plan, the first reply comes the same working day.
The 2025 schedule instead listed a first reply within 1 working day for Studio, but that document is archived, so the current answer is the same working day.
Starter clients can have 1 active request open at a time.
This is the cap from 1 January 2026, and the handbook confirms Starter 1.
The Partner plan includes 130 design hours.
These hours are a monthly budget rather than a promise of output.
No, the Studio plan does not include a monthly review call.
The monthly review call with the studio director is part of the Partner plan.
Source also states that the review call is part of Partner and not Studio.
The current naming add-on costs €2,500, and it is available only as an add-on to a Brand Sprint, covering up to three name candidates.
An older price of €2,000 has been superseded.
The current non-profit discount is 15% off retainers for a registered non-profit.
It does not apply to fixed-price projects and cannot be combined with the annual prepayment discount.
A retainer can be paused once per year, for up to two months.
The client must give 14 days' written notice before the next invoice, and during a pause Northwind does not invoice the paused months.
The Partner plan is €11,200 per month in the current reference matrix, which would be €134,400 per year before any prepayment discount.
The draft for 2026 proposes a Partner retainer of €12,000 per month and removal of the annual prepayment discount, but that is a draft and not in force.
I can't give a confirmed annual prepaid price based on these sources.
Clients gave a satisfaction score of 4.6 out of 5 in the 2025 survey, which had 22 responses from 31 clients asked.
The readout notes that this single score is the only satisfaction measure and is not broken down further.
Northwind's total liability under the agreement is limited to the fees paid under the agreement in the previous 12 months.
Nothing in that clause limits liability that cannot be limited under Dutch law.
Yes, it counts as a new round.
Feedback is due within 5 working days, and after 10 working days of silence the round is accepted, so notes arriving 12 working days after the draft are treated as a new round.
On a fixed-price project a further round costs €450.
Northwind will notify the client within 48 hours if it becomes aware of a personal data breach affecting client data it holds as processor.
The Northwind master services agreement states that it is governed by Dutch law.

Note that a client has asked for the governing law to be changed, but that change has not been agreed and must go through a formal contract amendment, so Dutch law applies unless and until a signed amendment says otherwise.
No, the studio is closed on 14 May 2026, which is Ascension Day.
The same closure is listed in the legal agreement.

Voor het precieze bedrag kunt u het beste contact opnemen met Northwind Studio.

Den genauen Preis des Studio-Plans kann ich daher nicht bestätigen.

A retainer can be paused once per year, for up to two months.

Hours do not accrue during a pause, and rolled-over hours expire at the start of it.

It cannot be combined with the 10% annual prepayment discount, so a client must choose one or the other.

No, unused retainer hours are never refunded or paid out, including when you cancel.
If you prepaid an annual retainer, unused months may be refunded, minus the discount you received for those months, but the hours within a paid month are still not refunded.
Yes, a retainer can be paused once per year for up to two months, with at least 14 days' written notice before the next invoice.

Ortiz Studio has already used this in source 1 by pausing July and August, which would mean the once-a-year pause is used up for that year.
No, Northwind does not write production code, build mobile apps, run ads, manage social media, or make video beyond a simple logo animation.
For development work, the studio refers clients to partner studios such as Pixelforge for web and Byteharbour for mobile, which the client contracts directly with no referral fee.
Northwind keeps project files for 24 months after the last invoice, then deletes them, and you can ask in writing for earlier deletion, which is confirmed within 10 working days.
Invoices and their supporting accounting records are kept for 7 years and are not deleted along with the project files.
Separately, Figma access for your team is removed 30 days after the engagement ends, so export your files before then.

The sources don't say whether a Northwind designer can be hired in-house, but they do describe a restriction: the agreement includes a non-solicitation clause for 12 months after the project ends, so you should talk to the studio director first.
A placement fee also applies if you want to hire someone.
If you never reply to a draft, the round is treated as accepted after 10 working days of silence, and we move on.

If you need more time, you should tell your account lead before the 5-working-day feedback window closes.
No.

The designer who owns the work is one senior designer, but Sandra said she wouldn't name that person until kickoff, which happens within ten working days of signing.

The 25% rush fee applies.

The account lead for Kestrel Analytics is Sandra Tsapljoek.
Her role is confirmed by the team directory and the case study, and she is also named as the account lead in the sales and pitch notes.
There is no Dutch VAT on Kestrel's invoice because Kestrel is an EU business outside the Netherlands, so the invoice is reverse charge and Kestrel accounts for the VAT in Ireland.

The outage was limited to uploads, and the other portal features were not reported as down.
Twenty-three clients were affected by the Harbor upload outage, meaning they could not upload a file during the 10:05 to 13:25 CET window on 14 April 2026.
Clients who did not need to upload during that window are not counted among them.
Paying the retainer annually in advance gets you 10% off, but this discount applies to the retainer only, not to fixed-price projects, and it cannot be combined with any other discount.
For example, the Tidepool Partner retainer paid annually would come to €120,960 per year.
Since the non-profit discount does not combine with the annual prepayment discount, you would choose one or the other.
The rush fee is 40% on top of the normal cost from 1 March 2026, up from 25% before that date.
Rush only applies once the account lead confirms it in writing, and a rush confirmed in writing before 1 March 2026 keeps the 25% rate.
The older glossary and template sources still show 25%, but they are dated earlier and the newer rate card and rush page supersede them.
A third revision round on a Brand Sprint costs €450 as a fixed-price extra round.
A rush on that round adds a 40% fee on top of the normal cost, since rush fees on fixed-price projects are 40% of the rushed part and extra rounds during a rush carry the same 40%.
The sources do not give a combined total, so I can't state the exact rushed price.
No, the urgent line is for Partner clients only, and Starter does not have it.
It is meant for problems that block a launch, reachable during working hours plus 07:00 to 09:00 CET.
Starter clients should raise a blocker through Harbor, where the first reply comes within 2 working days.
You can get one of the two discounts, not both, since they cannot be combined.
A registered non-profit receives 15% off a retainer, or you may choose annual prepayment for 10% instead.
The agency's handbook says to agree which single discount goes into the proposal before it is sent.

This is also how the August 2026 Brightlane report charged its rush request, with the 14 hours counted inside the 58 hours used.
If you prepaid an annual retainer and cancel, the unused months are refunded minus the discount you received for those months.
Unused hours inside a month are never refunded, and cancellation requires 30 days' written notice to your account lead.
On the Studio plan, Northwind gives a first reply the same working day, and this has applied since 1 January 2026.
Before that, Studio was within 1 working day.
The same-working-day promise covers requests received during the studio's open hours, 09:00 to 18:00 CET.
Starter clients can have 1 active request open at a time.
This cap applies from 1 January 2026.
Work beyond the limit waits until a request is finished.

Нет, неиспользованные часы не возвращаются ни при отмене, ни при паузе. Часы переносятся только на следующий месяц и затем сгорают, и их нельзя выплатить деньгами. Если вы оплатили год заранее, за неиспользованные месяцы может быть возврат денег, но за вычетом скидки, примененной к этим месяцам, а часы внутри оплаченного месяца все равно не возвращаются.

The Kestrel Analytics exception was a one-time decision tied to a delay Northwind caused, and it is explicitly not a policy change.
Hours are never refunded or paid out, and a longer rollover is not a term of the template.
The October 2025 draft proposed €6,200 a month for Studio, but that draft was rejected on 4 November 2025.
The Studio plan in force from 1 January 2026 is €5,800 a month, excluding VAT.
Northwind keeps project files for 24 months after the last invoice, and then deletes them in the ordinary course.
The clock runs from the last invoice, not from the kickoff or when a draft was made, and a later invoice (such as a continuing retainer) restarts it.
Invoices themselves are kept for 7 years and are not deleted as part of a file deletion.
Brand Sprint (code NW-SPR-B) costs €9,500 excluding VAT and takes 4 weeks.
This is the current 2026 price, and the 2025 price of €8,500 applies only to agreements signed before the 2026 renewal.
Northwind does not design or build native mobile apps, so the partner to contract for an app is Byteharbour, which builds React Native mobile apps from its Amsterdam office.
Byteharbour is a separate company, not a Northwind office, and clients contract them directly with no subcontracting or referral fee.
You receive 8 free design hours, added once to your account, when a company you refer signs a retainer.
There is no cash, bounty, or invoice split, and the hours are the whole program.
You should tell your account lead the company's name before they sign.
The Partner plan paid annually in advance costs €120,960 per year, which is 10% off the monthly price of €11,200.
This prepayment discount applies to the retainer only and does not combine with any other discount.
Kestrel used 121 hours in May 2026, out of 130 available.
The remaining 9 hours roll over to June.
Northwind designed the Becker Freight website layouts at 360, 768, and 1280 pixels, and those three are the ones to build.
The team was told not to invent a fourth breakpoint from an exploration frame.
Northwind's total liability arising out of the Agreement, for any event or series of connected events, is limited to the fees paid under the Agreement in the previous 12 months.
This cap does not limit liability that cannot be limited under Dutch law, and it is the Client's exclusive financial remedy for claims arising out of the Services, subject to that exception.
Clients rated their satisfaction at 4.6 out of 5, based on a survey of 31 clients of whom 22 responded.
Account leads are told to quote both figures, 4.6 out of 5 and "22 responded," rather than a rounded-up version.
Under the current Master Services Agreement template, the agreement is governed by Dutch law, and the courts of Rotterdam have exclusive jurisdiction, subject to any right of appeal Dutch law gives.
The template is issued in English and remains governed by Dutch law even if a translation is later prepared.
Northwind notifies the client within 48 hours of becoming aware of a personal data breach affecting client data it holds as processor.
The notice covers what happened, which data is affected, and what has been done to contain it, and if facts are still incomplete at 48 hours, Northwind sends what it has and follows up with the rest.
The client remains responsible for any notice it owes to individuals or authorities.

Body text must reach a contrast ratio of 4.5:1 against its background.

No, Quill Notes kept its existing name after the naming work.

The redesign focused on the quote form, which was rebuilt as a sequence a dispatcher can complete without help, with drawn validation states.
The site was built by Pixelforge, not Northwind, under Becker's own contract with them.
Der Studio-Plan (Code NW-RET-M) kostet €5.800 pro Monat, exklusive MwSt. Er umfasst 64 Design-Stunden und 2 aktive Anfragen gleichzeitig.
De toeslag voor spoedwerk is 40% sinds 1 maart 2026; daarvoor was het 25%.
Welk percentage geldt, hangt af van de datum van de schriftelijke bevestiging door de account lead: is die van vóór 1 maart 2026, dan blijft het 25%.
Op een retainer wordt de toeslag in uren verrekend, bijvoorbeeld 10 uur spoed gebruikt 14 uur.
